## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `5e59433fc8741f7527b2be9a88f6cb0aff5d941e`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

- **`TranslationKeys` narrows.** It is `typeof en` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`), re-exported from `@object-ui/i18n`. It loses the 92 keys #25921 deletes and `validation.formInvalid`, which #26040 retires with its last reader (the field-list toast the card removes). The card thread found no reader of any of them in this repository, and `check-i18n-dead-keys` reports no new CONFIRMED key after the batch. A downstream host that indexed one of these members by property would lose it at type level. That is the same class of change as the objectui#4730 key retirements, which shipped as `patch` in this release group. Correct as declared.
- **`InvitationSignUpPrompt` is added to `@object-ui/app-shell`'s barrel (#26044).** This is additive. It is byte-identical to the head seat 2 reviewed (contract review 6413489249, PASS). Correct.
- **New keys** (`auth.*invitation*`, `map.*`, and the separator comment reworded): widening only. Correct.
- **plugin-map** (#26048): the component falls back to the record list on a style or tile failure. There is no exported type change; its changeset says `Clause-②: no`, which is correct.

### ② Semver level

There are four changesets, all `patch`: `25874-form-refusal-no-field-toast` (components, i18n), `25886-invitation-arrival-copy` (app-shell, console, i18n; `Clause-②: yes`), `25889-map-style-failure-notice` (plugin-map, i18n) and `25921-delete-dead-i18n-keys` (i18n; `Clause-②: yes`). `25874`'s changeset says `Clause-②: no` although it removes one unread key. The PR body's `Clause-②: yes` line covers it, and the level does not change. Consistent with the fixed release group.

### ③ Boundary flags

- This is a batch PR. #26040, #26044 and #26048 were merged in so the change lands as one merge-queue entry. The diff against `main` is exactly the union of the four PRs' files plus three per-package sdui records. The non-locale files are byte-identical to each source head, checked by the seat with `git rev-parse` per path.
- The card thread pushed once with `OS_ALLOW_CARD_TRAILER_PUSH=1`, because pre-force-push history inside #26040 and #26048 carries card trailers. The repository squash-merges with `squash_merge_commit_message=PR_BODY`, so no commit message reaches `main`. `git log origin/main..HEAD` carries no closing keyword, and the body uses a keyword only for `Part of #25921`. Recorded as a deviation; it has no effect on what lands.
- The ⛔ paths (`ui/.github/**`, root `ci.yml`) are untouched. The PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay write).

Implemented-by: `session_01FpUtgwNrSiRgWJ8GAepPeP`
Reviewed-by: `session_017iXjUm1rujwDk7f3KT1Pkk`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · seat `domain:ui#1` · 2026-10-26T15:44Z

Head `5e59433fc874` (read from the PR object). This is the i18n batch: #25921's 92 dead keys, plus #26040, #26044 and #26048 merged in.

- **Shape.** Draft on `main`. `Part of #25921`; the other three cards are referenced without a keyword (see the body's batch table). `Clause-②: yes`, with the TIER_DEFAULT contract review above (6420248632, PASS). Four root changesets, all patch.
- **Checks pinned to the head.** All check runs completed. 0 failing, 0 pending; the seat's landing script verifies this before posting.
- **Batch integrity.** The diff against `main` is the union of the four PRs' files plus the `components` / `i18n` / `plugin-map` source records, and nothing else. Every non-locale file is byte-identical to its source PR's head. The dev checked each source PR's locale additions and deletions line by line across the ten packs. The one `zh.ts` conflict against `main` keeps #26045's `退出登录` and #25921's deletion.
- **Gates.** Re-recorded once, under the lock; exactly three packages moved and `check-sdui-manifest` is green. `check-eager-locale-catalogues` exits 0 after a Console build. 348 test files / 4032 tests were green on the touched areas. 47 derived gates exit 0.
- **Per-package order.** i18n: #26045 merged at 14:42Z, so this batch is next. components and plugin-map have no other open PR ahead of it.

Landing: ready + auto-merge through the relay. After it merges: #26040 is closed as superseded and #25874 closed by seat 1; #26044 / #26048 are handled by seat 2; #26172 (#26202) and #25922 get the go.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [40356711668](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40356711668) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test UI (7/16)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40356711668/job/121691930100)** — 失败步骤: Run the ui tests (shard 7/16)

  ```
  × has no near-spelling for any of them — unlike objectui#6041, nothing here is a rename 5ms
  FAIL   unit  packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.specKeyObjectPayload.test.ts > the instrument > has no near-spelling for any of them — unlike objectui#6041, nothing here is a rename
    ↳ 失败原因: AssertionError: expected 48 to be 47 // Object.is equality
  ```
- **[Test UI (12/16)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40356711668/job/121691930142)** — 失败步骤: Run the ui tests (shard 12/16)

  ```
  × has no on/off flag to rename to — `enable` is a capabilities object, not a boolean 10ms
  FAIL   unit  packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.retiredObjectEnabled.test.ts > objectui#6238 · the schema oracle — both tombstone keys are refused BY NAME > has no on/off flag to rename t
    ↳ 失败原因: AssertionError: expected 48 to be 47 // Object.is equality
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.specKeyObjectPayload.test.ts` — 24h 内已弹出 **5 个 PR**（#26033、#26053、#26158、#26177、#26197），分属 **4 条投机栈** ⇒ **4 次独立命中**。汇总 issue：#26222（已刷新）
- `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.retiredObjectEnabled.test.ts` — 24h 内已弹出 **5 个 PR**（#26033、#26053、#26158、#26177、#26197），分属 **4 条投机栈** ⇒ **4 次独立命中**。汇总 issue：#26223（已刷新）
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 29 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
